title: Intersection Conveyor

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Merge two separate conveyor lines into one

body:
"3 Way Intersection Conveyor - Try toggling the switch between all 3 modes! It's really useful for making any form of sorting system"


The Intersection Conveyor is a structure that can be purchased from The Oak Depot. It is a T-shaped conveyor belt section that allows for advanced conveyor belt setups.

Functionality

When placed, the Intersection Conveyor defaults to its center position. Toggling the switch determines the direction of the output; the other two conveyor sections will become inputs.

The Intersection Conveyor serves two separate purposes. The first purpose is merging two separate inputs into one output, such as bringing together both a wood processing line and a stone processing line together for a unified output to a truck or trailer. The second purpose is to create a filtering or sorting system, which generally involves the use of Logic. A rudimentary use would be to create a junction that sits between a Refinery and a Forge to allow Lithium and Magnetite to bypass the Forge, allowing them to retain their full value.

Trivia

  • Unlike almost all other conveyor belt sections, the Intersection Conveyor does not have a large version.
